anchors: Placement/promotion judgment runs INLINE on the session model
decision: The placement and promotion judgment runs inline on the session model, and the skill carries a tier note saying so and offering a model switch below opus-class.

evidence.text: the session-model convention of process-agents-subagent-driven-development (b13255aa); dropped by the skill rewrite cec8867b and restored in e3056501

reopen_if: The judgment can run without the whole loaded store (a dispatched subagent at a pinned tier), or a session can pick its own model.
why: The inline judgment needs the whole loaded store and is capability-sensitive; a rewrite dropped the note once and it had to be restored.

decision: Not adopted: a Step 5 instruction to re-run ref_map over the reduced move set whenever a planned move is dropped.
reopen_if: The engine stops refusing a move that would dangle inbound refs, or the skill allows --force on such a move.
why: The memory engine already refuses a down-move that would leave inbound refs dangling, and Step 5 says a refused move aborts and forbids --force there, so a citer that stays put cannot strand a ref silently.

anchors: a dated incident record or a "since X" statement
decision: A claim versionrot reports as dated (an ISO date or 'measured' in its sentence, or 'since X') is not a staleness candidate.

evidence.text: One real chain: 79 superseded before, 30 superseded and 49 dated after; the 30 still listed are undated claims.

reopen_if: A dated claim is found to have hidden a fact that was really stale.
why: A re-check of a chain's superseded claims found the dated ones all true on the version they name, so a worklist of them spends a reviewer for nothing.

anchors: propose mode lists the move in the report with its cost
decision: A misplacement whose routed level is the tree top follows the dream mode: propose mode lists the re-home in the report with its cost (the bytes it adds to the top block) for the user's approval and does not apply it; auto mode applies it and prints its cost in the report; a manual run under `off` proposes it, as propose mode does. Below the top it is re-homed whatever should-promote says, in every mode.

evidence.text: User decisions 2026-11-10: Propose in propose mode, apply in auto; Propose, like propose (Recommended) for a manual run under off. Measured: store history 2026-11-09, 159 of 163 pointers arriving at the top in a day were moves up; moves up outnumbered moves down about 35 to 1. RED/GREEN probes 2026-11-10 on opus and haiku: the old text re-homed to the top with no cost line in propose and auto; the new text proposes in propose and off and applies with its cost in auto.

reopen_if: Pointer placement is generated from topics (phase 2), the top's block stops loading in every session, or the top block's growth under auto mode makes the user revisit the choice.
why: The top's block loads in every session of the tree and the misplacement test passes for nearly any general lesson, so the ungated re-home was the main route facts took to the top. The user chose to keep auto mode hands-off and make every move to the top carry its cost.

anchors: Length is a COST question, met by representation
decision: The firing check never rewrites a hook for its length; a hook over the soft cap at a broad level is reported as a shortening proposal with its length and its level's block bytes, never shortened unasked.

evidence.text: User decisions 2026-11-09: Over 350, to 350 (Recommended); Today twice + shortened, 6 runs (Recommended). RED/GREEN probes 2026-11-10: the old text left a 430-character hook unreported; the new text reports it as a shortening proposal on opus and haiku.

reopen_if: A firing test shows hooks shortened to the soft cap fire as often as today's, and shortening becomes a pass of its own.
why: The old sentence forbade any length rewrite while the passes note met size by representation; shortening unasked waits on a firing test.

anchors: EXCEPT a move of a fact to the tree top (the anchor), which it PROPOSES
decision: Propose mode applies safe private-memory consolidation except a move of a fact to the tree top, whether a misplacement re-home or a promotion, which it proposes in the report with its cost (the UTF-8 bytes of its pointer line plus the newline) for the user's approval and does not apply; auto mode applies such a move and prints its cost in the report; a manual run under `off` proposes it, as propose mode does. Moves below the top are applied in every mode. A promotion's `promoted` call runs only once the fact has moved.

evidence.text: User decision 2026-11-10: Propose in propose mode, apply in auto (propose mode lists top moves for approval); dream_state.py mode read propose at the time, and the option named that propose mode's meaning had to change. Probes 2026-11-10: the old Mode text applied a move to the top in propose mode; the new text proposes it on opus and haiku, and the qualified promote branch reads as consistent on both.

reopen_if: The user changes what a mode means, rules that a corroborated promotion is exempt from the carve-out, or pointer placement is generated from topics (phase 2).
why: The user chose to let the mode knob decide moves to the tree top. Propose mode already applied private-memory moves, so without this carve-out propose mode would have kept moving facts to the top unasked. The promotion branch is covered too because GREEN probes on opus and haiku both read an unqualified 'promote: move it to the tree top' as contradicting the carve-out.

decision: Every dream report carries the pointer-block lines store_manifest.py verify prints, as printed, names every slug that arrived at the tree top (from verify's --json data.levels[]), and lists every move to the top with its cost: as a proposal in propose mode and under off, as applied in auto mode.

evidence.text: Design 2026-11-09, cost side; verify's cost lines in store_manifest.py _render_costs and cost_report, tested in test_store_manifest.py; user decision 2026-11-10 that auto mode applies a move to the top and prints its cost. Probes 2026-11-10: the old report contract gave counts only; the new one names the lines and the top's arrivals on opus and haiku.

reopen_if: verify stops printing per-level block lines, or placement is generated from topics.
why: The store-growth rule counted facts, and a move to the top keeps the count while every session pays for the line; the cost has to be visible where the run is judged, in either mode. verify's text form prints how many slugs arrived and left, so the names come from its JSON form.

anchors: EXCEPT a misplacement re-home to the tree top (the anchor), which it PROPOSES
decision: Propose mode applies safe private-memory consolidation except a MISPLACEMENT re-home to the tree top, which it proposes in the report with its cost (the UTF-8 bytes of its pointer line plus the newline) for the user's approval and does not apply; auto mode applies such a re-home and prints its cost; a manual run under `off` proposes it, as propose mode does. A re-home below the top and a corroborated promotion to the top (should-promote printed promote) are applied in every mode, the promotion's cost printed in the report for information, and `promoted` runs after the move.

evidence.text: User decision 2026-11-10: Misplacements only (a corroborated promotion is applied without asking in propose mode; only a misplacement to the top follows the mode). GREEN probe 2026-11-10 on opus: propose and off propose a misplacement to the top with its cost, auto applies it and prints the cost, a corroborated promote is applied in propose and off with promoted run, a re-home below the top is applied in every mode, and a mixed batch applies only the promotion and the below-top re-home.

reopen_if: The user extends the mode to promotions to the top, a measurement shows promotions rather than misplacements drive the top block's growth, or pointer placement is generated from topics (phase 2).
why: The user ruled that only a misplacement to the top follows the mode: a corroborated promotion has already passed the corroboration gate, which stays its only gate, so it is applied without asking. The earlier entry extended the carve-out to every move to the top, promotions included, which the user did not choose.

decision: Every dream report carries the pointer-block lines store_manifest.py verify prints, as printed, names every slug that arrived at the tree top (from verify's --json data.levels[]), and lists every misplacement re-home to the top with its cost (as a proposal in propose mode and under off, as applied in auto) and every corroborated promotion to the top as applied, with its cost.

evidence.text: User decision 2026-11-10: Misplacements only, with the promotion's cost printed for information. verify's cost lines in store_manifest.py _render_costs and cost_report; GREEN probe 2026-11-10 on opus lists the misplacement as a proposal with its cost and the promotion as applied with its cost.

reopen_if: verify stops printing per-level block lines, or placement is generated from topics.
why: A move to the top keeps the fact count while every session pays for the line, so the cost has to be visible where the run is judged. After the user scoped the mode to misplacements, a promotion is applied unasked, and its cost line is the only place the report shows what it added to the top.

anchors: Length is a COST question, met by representation
a large-index warning's advice to trim long hooks is met by step 6's shortening proposal
decision: The firing check never rewrites a hook for its length; a hook over the soft cap at a broad level is reported as a shortening proposal with its length and its level's block bytes, never shortened unasked, and a large-index warning's advice to trim long hooks is met by that proposal, not by an applied trim.

evidence.text: User decisions 2026-11-09: Over 350, to 350 (Recommended); Today twice + shortened, 6 runs (Recommended). Review finding 2026-11-10 that step 8's size-warning line pointed nowhere.

reopen_if: A firing test shows hooks shortened to the soft cap fire as often as today's, and shortening becomes a pass of its own.
why: The old sentence forbade any length rewrite while the passes note met size by representation; shortening unasked waits on a firing test. reconcile's large-index warning recommends trimming long hooks, which read alone would license the unasked rewrite this rule forbids.
